status: Runtime inspected; expansion awaits Level Design specification. No runtime or roadmap edits made.

movement.coordinates: Logical pixels; 960x540 viewport; player position is collision top-left.
movement.caveat: Analytic estimates, not a collision simulation. Discrete physics, acceleration and edge overlap alter reach. Design for slower Sean and validate both routes.
movement.recommended_geometry: Required rises 45-65px; comfortable same-height gaps <=100-120px; landing surfaces >=100px. No mandatory max-range jumps. Higher scenery needs stepping surfaces.

architecture.runtime: scripts/game.gd owns procedural Node2D movement, collision, combat, camera, checkpoints and victory; no tilemap/navigation system.
architecture.platform_collision: One-way tops for player; no side/ceiling collision. Platforms block projectile sweeps. Flat floor always catches player: no pits/fall deaths.
architecture.completion: player.x >=2300 and enemies empty; HUD denominator hardcoded 3. Must replace with authored encounter totals and explicit exit condition.
architecture.camera: Horizontal only, target player.x-320, speed400; world bounds 0..width-960.
architecture.presentation: scripts/world_art.gd draws background and sprites independently from collision. New scenery/platform art goes to Bestiary / Art.
architecture.suggested_refactor: One validated level-data definition for world bounds, solid/surface rectangles, prop art placement, enemy spawns, checkpoints and exit. Keep art top surfaces aligned with collision.

enemies.playable: Flushfiend/toilet only; 40HP, floor-bound sine bounce, contact damage; persistent aggro within horizontal280, patrol80, chase115, stop6.
enemies.constraints: No platform traversal, gravity/pathfinding, height-aware detection, projectile attacks or real flying enemy AI. All enemies currently updated off-camera; persistent pursuit may accumulate a horde. Current movement cannot respect physical scenery side walls.
enemies.widow: Damage atlas/80HP metadata available; flight behavior is not implemented. Requires explicit scope and movement integration; do not claim ready to place as a distinct enemy.
enemies.clogfather: 720HP metadata/HUD preview only; no boss gameplay. Its 30 Sean-hit timing needs retuning before encounter implementation.

weapons.notes: Horizontal muzzle-path range, swept collision; no vertical aiming, melee or explosives implemented.

proposed_encounter_budget.simultaneous_pressure: Usually 2-3 active threats, brief peaks4; space encounters to prevent unintended persistent-chase stacks.
proposed_encounter_budget.duration_caveat: Target only. Walking 6000-8000px takes roughly26-34s for Sean; meaningful combat, optional routes and scenery must earn duration. Do not pad solely with corridor length.
proposed_encounter_budget.first_delivery: Build an authored route with current toilet enemy; reserve new monster encounters until their behavior is implemented and verified.

reset_rules: Death fully heals and teleports to latest checkpoint; defeated enemies remain dead, surviving enemies retain aggro. Restart recreates encounter and clears checkpoint/aggro. Design safe respawn recovery.

Enemy IDs, spawn positions and intended active encounter budget
Required versus optional new mechanics/monster types
Story beats and dialogue triggers coordinated with Storyboarding
engineering_validation: Persistent pursuit and off-camera encounter accumulation
Checkpoint safety, retry and win conditions
Headless packaged build, archived version, roadmap after aligned spec
